$comment: Jev judgment that tags a saved item (tools/content.ts). One boolean per tag, asked together over the item's title, summary and opening text. A tag is kept at or above `threshold`. Tune here, not in code: an edit changes the stored questions hash, so old verdicts stay readable.
instructions: An item a family member saved: a web page, photo, voice note, document or note. Answer whether this tag describes it.

tags.school: School: notices, excursions, permission notes, timetables, homework, newsletters, school events.
tags.kids-activities: A child's sport, club, class, lesson or holiday program outside school.
tags.event: Something happening on a date: an invitation, show, party, meeting or booking.
tags.recipe: A recipe, meal idea or cooking technique.
tags.health: Health, medical, dental, fitness, sleep or wellbeing.
tags.money: A bill, receipt, invoice, price, bank or insurance matter.
tags.home: The house: repairs, appliances, garden, cleaning, furniture, utilities.
tags.travel: Trips, flights, places to visit, maps, accommodation.
tags.shopping: Something to buy, a product, a wishlist item.
tags.to-read: An article, essay or long piece meant to be read later.
tags.to-watch: A video, film, show or talk meant to be watched later.
tags.learning: How-to, tutorial, explainer, course or reference to learn from.
tags.work: A parent's job or professional matter.
